_comment: ngsolve nonlinear_elasticity#1 (load stepping must warm-start from the previous converged GridFunction). Observed 2026-08-06 on NGSolve 6.2.2604: GridFunction.Set(cf, definedon=mesh.Boundaries(...)) zeroes EVERY free dof, so the catalog nonlinear_elasticity_2d/_3d loop cold-restarts each step; at the shipped defaults (maxh=0.1, order 2, disp 0.5, 10 steps) Newton counts grow 6/8/9 and step 4 dies with 'UmfpackInverse: Numeric factorization failed'. Overwriting only the constrained dofs via Projector(fes.FreeDofs(), False) converges all 10 steps in a constant 6 iterations with max|u_y| = 0.5 exactly. Also pins that solvers.Newton returns (status, numit), which is why the templates print 'Newton iters=0'.
